Asia–Europe rates were largely stable, but cargo demand is weakening for apparel and textile buyers.

title: Global cotton tightening gives India a rare raw-material advantage
summary:
USDA expects 2026/27 world cotton output at 117.6 million bales, below mill demand of 122.9 million bales, the highest in six years.
Stocks are forecast to fall to 69.7 million bales, the lowest since 2018/19, as mills consume more than farmers produce.
India is the only major producer expected to increase output; the US, China, Brazil, Pakistan and Australia are expected to decline.
